name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: Senior Professional specializing in Sales Enablement, Product Strategy, and Learning Operations with over 8 years of experience driving adoption for enterprise solutions and global tech platforms (Meta). Proven track record governing high-scale training programs (Next Level Bootcamp) under strict PMO guidelines, managing cross-functional global stakeholders, and coordinating virtual/instructor-led certification paths. Expert in leveraging AI automation (n8n, Supabase, native AI workflows) and Business Intelligence (Power BI) to streamline operations, track learning analytics, and optimize program budgets. Combines highly organized project management with advanced facilitation techniques (Thinking Environment) to deliver measurable business impact.

bullets: Project Governance & Enablement: Coordinated and governed the end-to-end execution of the Next Level Bootcamp program under strict PMO guidelines, managing master schedules, defining milestone success criteria, and driving operational resource planning.

Training & Certification Operations: Acted as the operation's technical reference for Meta ad strategies, absorbing official client materials and strategically replicating product innovations and Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for 150+ Meta Marketing Pros.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Acted as the strategic bridge between global product lines, quality assurance, and outsourced consultant teams to maintain clear project documentation, manage timelines, and align deliverables with core business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Partnered with the MIS data team to leverage Power BI and Excel dashboards, translating complex operational data into actionable progress reports and performance reviews for senior leadership.
Provide technical training to the team on Meta internal tools, driving onboarding and replicating training programs on proprietary CRMs and practical native AI implementations.

Scope Definition & Lifecycle Ownership: Took absolute ownership of a new conversational software launch from initial requirements gathering through deployment, establishing timelines and budget parameters within a high-agency environment.
Workflow Implementation: Built and orchestrated core backend automation systems using n8n, Supabase databases, and API structures over a VPS, optimizing digital communication funnels for scalability.

Led the AI data strategy, structuring automated scraping routines across blogs, Google Maps, and web sources to collect, centralize, and organize business data that was previously fragmented across the web.
Drove business development and B2B partnerships, leading the prospecting of partner venues, pitching the value proposition (AI-driven visibility), and closing the initial commercial contracts.

Budget & Timeline Controls: Controlled project scopes and financial budgets for multiple concurrent accounts, coordinating internal workflows and managing specialized resource execution to prevent project roadblocks.

Agency Account Leadership: Managed a specialized boutique agency focused on SMBs, leading the complete client onboarding transition and directing web development, brand identity, and positioning projects from conception to final delivery.

Digital Campaign Optimization: Engineered high-converting web assets, e-commerce landing pages, and search optimization (SEO) roadmaps, applying UX writing principles to align customer journeys with client growth objectives.

Funnel Coordination & CRM Integration: Automated communication pipelines and lead generation workflows between Bitrix24 and Sendpulse CRMs via webhooks, enhancing internal project tracking and execution efficiency.

Specialized in the global Thinking Environment methodology to build high-impact technical narratives, applying active listening and facilitation concepts to create strategic content for social media, brand positioning, and paid media.
Optimized commercial workflows and CRM automations via API/Webhooks, structuring intelligent lead nurturing flows to maximize sales conversion and reduce friction along the customer journey.
